EFS/S11.title: Photo with no patients and an unreadable file, both contexts: explicit message, nobody added
EFS/S11.detail: 14/14 judged cells passed; the corrupt-file leg (our addition) is record-only, 9/9 notes as expected (newspec-c/vis-efs-s11-photo-empty-unreadable.spec.ts, desktop Chromium, one fixture patient + one resident). Media made in the run: a cafeteria-menu JPEG (Tomato soup, Grilled cheese, ...) and 2 KB of random bytes named efs-corrupt.jpg. No model: ai/vision:scanCensusSheet was answered in the browser the way the server ends for each photo - the menu as a successful read with zero rows, the random bytes as a failed read (a provider rejects non-image bytes). Hospital menu: 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.', Nursing Home menu: 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.'; no row or Add button offered, no menu text on screen. Corrupt file, both contexts: 'The photo couldn't be read. Check your connection and try again, or retake the photo.'; no raw provider error or 'undefined' on screen, no row offered. After closing each sheet the lists still hold only the fixture patient / resident, and the server holds exactly 1 patient and 1 resident. Recorded: the client sends any picked file to the server unchecked (the 2 KB random file went out as a 2,732-character base64 image in both contexts); what the real vision provider answers for such bytes is not exercised (no live model); both 'no patients / residents found' messages are plain text, not live regions. B01 (real reads on dev always say 'no patients found') is not touched by this scenario: the photo really has nobody on it.
